title: From Rooftop Beans to Pocket Parks: How Cities Grow Room to Breathe
title_zh: 从屋顶菜园到口袋公园：城市如何长出呼吸的空间
intro_zh: 本文约 548 词，共 8 段。文章以城市绿地为主题，介绍口袋公园、树木降温、城市生物多样性、居民健康收益、屋顶农场等具体做法与数据，也指出维护成本与分布不均的问题。含 6 个 CET-4 核心词，句子复杂度中等，理解难度约 85%-90%。

paragraphs.en: On a warm Tuesday at noon, hundreds of office workers in central Shanghai walk two blocks, sit down on a bench under a row of plane trees, and eat lunch while birds argue above them. Twenty minutes later they return to their desks. For city planners, scenes like this explain a quiet change: green space is no longer seen as decoration, but as basic equipment for city life.
paragraphs.zh: 在一个温暖的周二中午，上海中心城区的数百名上班族走过两个街区，在梧桐树下的长椅上坐下，一边吃午饭，一边听鸟儿在头顶吵闹。二十分钟后，他们回到办公桌前。对城市规划者来说，这样的场景解释了一种悄然的变化：绿地不再被看作装饰，而被视为城市生活的基本配置。

paragraphs.en: The most visible form of this change is the pocket park — a small plot, sometimes no bigger than a tennis court, squeezed between buildings. New York has built more than 500 of them since the 1960s; Shanghai opened over 80 in 2023 alone. Size is not the point. A single mature tree with a broad canopy can cool the air beneath it, cut traffic noise, and give a tired worker a place to sit.
paragraphs.zh: 这种变化最明显的形式是“口袋公园”——一小块土地，有时不比一个网球场大，被挤在楼宇之间。纽约自20世纪60年代以来已建成500多个这样的公园；仅2023年，上海就开放了80多个。面积并不是关键。一棵树冠宽阔的大树，就能让它下方的空气变凉、削减交通噪音，还能给疲惫的上班族一个坐下的地方。

paragraphs.en: Heat is the strongest argument. Asphalt and concrete absorb sunlight all day and release it at night, so city centres can be 3 to 5 °C warmer than nearby villages. Trees work in the opposite way. Their leaves take in much of the sunlight that would otherwise hit the pavement, and water evaporating from those leaves cools the surrounding air. Measurements in Madrid found that a shaded street was up to 12 °C cooler at noon than an open one a block away.
paragraphs.zh: 高温是最有力的理由。沥青和混凝土整天吸收阳光，到了夜里又把热量释放出来，因此市中心可能比附近的乡村高出3到5℃。树木的作用恰好相反。树叶拦下原本会打在路面上的一部分阳光，而叶片蒸发出的水分又让周围空气变凉。马德里的实测发现，中午时一条有树荫的街道，比一个街区外没有遮挡的街道最多低12℃。

paragraphs.en: Green space also brings back biodiversity, the variety of living things. Singapore, which calls itself a city in a garden, keeps about 47 per cent of its land under green cover and has recorded more than 500 species of birds, butterflies and dragonflies inside the city. Even a small garden with native flowers can support bees and other insects that have almost disappeared from the surrounding streets.
paragraphs.zh: 绿地还带回了生物多样性，也就是生物的多样化。自称“花园中的城市”的新加坡，约47%的土地保持绿色覆盖，并在城市范围内记录到500多种鸟类、蝴蝶和蜻蜓。哪怕只是一小块种着本地花卉的花园，也能养活那些几乎从周边街道消失的蜜蜂和其他昆虫。

paragraphs.en: For residents, the benefits are personal. Researchers in Britain followed 20,000 people and found that those who spent at least 120 minutes a week in parks reported better health and greater happiness — and it did not matter whether the time was spent in one long visit or several short ones. Parents with young children, older people and shift workers gain the most, because they are least able to leave the city for the countryside.
paragraphs.zh: 对居民来说，好处是切身而个人的。英国的研究人员跟踪了两万人，发现每周至少在公园里待120分钟的人，报告的健康状况和幸福感更好——而且这些时间是集中一次用完还是分成几次短访，并没有区别。家里有幼儿的父母、老年人和倒班工作者受益最大，因为他们最没有条件离开城市去乡下。

paragraphs.en: Some cities are now looking upward. On a rooftop in Brooklyn, an area of about one acre has been turned into a farm that produces roughly 20 tonnes of vegetables a year and holds rainwater that would otherwise flood the drains below. Similar projects in Hong Kong and Rotterdam help restore soil, cool buildings and feed local markets.
paragraphs.zh: 一些城市现在开始向上看。在布鲁克林的一处屋顶上，约一英亩的地方被改造成农场，每年出产大约20吨蔬菜，并蓄住原本会涌入下方排水沟的雨水。香港和鹿特丹的类似项目则有助于恢复土壤、为建筑降温，并向本地市场供应食物。

paragraphs.en: Not every project succeeds. Roof gardens need strong floors, constant water and careful maintenance, and a young tree may die in its first dry summer. Critics also warn that green space is not spread fairly: richer districts usually have more of it, while crowded neighbourhoods have less. A park cannot replace a forest, and it will not solve air pollution on its own.
paragraphs.zh: 并非每个项目都能成功。屋顶花园需要坚固的楼板、持续的水源和细致的维护，一棵小树也可能在第一个干旱的夏天死去。批评者还警告说，绿地的分布并不公平：较富裕的城区通常绿地更多，而拥挤的街区则更少。一座公园无法取代一片森林，也无法独自解决空气污染。

paragraphs.en: Still, the direction is clear. Cities that once competed for the tallest tower now compete for the coolest street and the busiest garden. When a child in a crowded district can watch a butterfly land on a flower five minutes from home, something important is happening. Green space is not a luxury added at the end of the plan; it is what allows a city, and the people in it, to thrive.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管如此，方向是明确的。曾经比谁的高楼更高的城市，如今比谁的街道更凉爽、谁的花园更热闹。当一个拥挤街区里的孩子能在离家五分钟的地方看蝴蝶落在花上，就说明有重要的事情正在发生。绿地不是规划末尾添上的奢侈品；它正是让一座城市以及其中的人们得以茁壮成长的东西。

questions.q: What is the main message of the passage?
options: Pocket parks cost far less to build than large country forests.
Urban green space should be treated as necessary city equipment, not just decoration.
Wealthy districts should give their parks to crowded neighbourhoods.
Rooftop farms can take the place of traditional farming in the countryside.
questions.explain: 全文从口袋公园、降温、生物多样性、居民健康到屋顶农场，都在说明绿地已成为城市生活的基本配置，而不只是点缀。A、C、D均为文中未提或与原文相悖的推断。

questions.q: According to paragraph 3, how do trees help lower the temperature of a street?
options: They block the wind so that cool air stays in the street.
Their leaves take in sunlight and the water they release cools the air.
They send heat back into the sky during the night.
They prevent asphalt from being laid on the road.
questions.explain: 第三段说树叶拦下本会打在路面上的阳光（take in much of the sunlight），叶片蒸发的水分使周围空气变凉，故选B。吸收并夜间释放热量的是沥青和混凝土，而非树木。

questions.q: What can be inferred from the British study mentioned in paragraph 5?
options: Only long visits to a park can improve people's health.
The health benefits depend on how often a person visits a park.
Several short visits a week can work as well as one long visit.
People must take exercise in parks in order to feel happier.
questions.explain: 原文指出120分钟无论是一次长访还是几次短访，效果没有差别（it did not matter whether...），可推出C。A、B与原文相反，D属于文中未提及的推断。

questions.q: The word 'thrive' in the last paragraph is closest in meaning to
questions.explain: thrive意为“茁壮成长、兴旺发达”，与grow and do well最接近。B只强调体积变大，C、D与语境无关。
